What can it power?

Phones and laptops: Plenty of capacity for repeated charging.

Refrigerator: Suitable for many models during a short outage, depending on startup surge and actual energy use.

Electric heaters and kettles: Power Lifting mode can support certain resistive heating devices up to 2,700 W, but this mode does not provide 2,700 W of continuous power for every appliance.

Important limitation: The AC180 has about 1.15 kWh of stored energy, so it is better suited to short outages and portable use than running high-power appliances for an entire day. Actual runtime depends on load and conversion losses.
